errors.text_span: 角色标签顺序为避免、回避、逃避、回避、规避、回避
errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly lists the x-axis labels. The correct order is 避免, 回避, 逃避, 躲避, 规避. The description misses '躲避' and incorrectly repeats '回避'.

errors.text_span: 其颜色分别对应于不同的词汇类，包括蓝色“避免”、“橙色”回避、“黄色”逃避、“青色”回避、 “灰色”规避、 “紫色”回避
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates a legend by incorrectly mapping colors to the x-axis categories (避免, 回避, etc.). The actual legend maps colors to categories like AGT, EXP, CONT, etc., which is completely ignored in this part of the description.

errors.text_span: “避免”的柱状图最高，约为35.00%，其高度约为35个百分点。“回避”的柱状图接近于32.00%，其高度约为32个百分点。“逃避”的柱状图约为26.00%，其高度约为26个百分点。“回避”的柱状图约为25.00%，其高度约为25个百分点，“规避”的柱状图约为22.00%，其高度约为22个百分点。“回避”的柱状图约为17.00%，其高度约为17个百分点
errors.evidence: This section incorrectly treats the x-axis labels (e.g., '避免') as if they are data series from the legend. It reports single values for them, which is a fundamental misinterpretation of how a grouped bar chart is structured. The data series are defined in the legend (AGT, EXP, CONT, etc.), not by the x-axis categories.
The description claims the value for 'eSUCC' is about 13.00%. However, all bars for the 'eSUCC' category in the chart are below 3%.
The description claims the value for 'TIME' is about 8.00%. However, all bars for the 'TIME' category in the chart are below 4%.

The description completely fails to mention the actual legend and the categories it contains (AGT, EXP, PAT, DATV, CONT, etc.), which are essential for understanding the chart. It instead hallucinates a legend based on x-axis labels.

errors.text_span: “TIME”的柱状图约为8.00%...“LOC”的柱状图约为6.00%...“MANN”的柱状图约为5.00%...“MEAS”的柱状图约为5.00%...“eCOO”的柱状图约为4.00%
errors.evidence: The description reports a single value for entire data series (TIME, LOC, MANN, etc.) that have multiple different values across the x-axis categories. This is an extreme over-generalization that misrepresents the data. For example, 'MANN' values range from ~5.5% to ~17.5%, but it is reported as a single value of 5.00%.
